_comment: Story 4.2 (D-1, DH-5): how an adventurer's Tarot card is drawn in the hire panel and on the roster (scenes/ui/TarotCard.tscn, PortraitSocket.resolve_card_art). frame: the texture drawn over the card, a placeholder until Story 25.22's frame set (swap it here; an empty or unloadable path draws a plain border). aspect: the card's width / height. header, window, footer: rects [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the card for the numeral or suit band, the art window and the name band (tools/ui/make_placeholder_tarot_frame.py draws the placeholder frame from these same numbers; a new frame with another layout changes them here). field_color: behind the art. silhouette_tint: 'class' (data/config/class_colors.json) or a hex colour, applied to the class silhouettes, never to a Tarot painting. silhouettes: class -> its silhouette (a white figure on transparent), drawn while the card has no painting at its portrait path. numeral_color / name_color: a Major card's numeral and every card's name. suits: label, colour and icon (a texture path; empty = the label in its colour) per Minor suit. silhouette_render: how scenes/dev/SilhouetteStudio.tscn renders the silhouettes from the class bodies (clip and time of the pose, yaw_deg of the 3/4 view, the PNG's size, the margin as a fraction, per-class overrides). back: the card's back (a locked Codex slot, Story 18.2; the flip reveal later), a texture path for Story 25.22's card back (P6); empty = a placeholder drawn in code (the field, a gold rule, a teal eye).
